title: Manifest-Driven OS Resource Catalog
description: F3 (child of parent ticket 26/07/17/GENERALIZE-APPS-ONTO-FRAMEWORK-PRIMITIVES, which the MCP tool could not resolve as a parent path — noted here instead): make the OS product's resource catalog manifest-driven instead of a hardcoded app roster. Own framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs (resource-catalog region: OS_RESOURCE_KIND_IDS, descriptor_presentation(), os_resource_media_capability()). Delete the hardcoded per-app matches; replace with a LazyLock<Mutex<HashMap<...>>> registry populated by a register_resource_descriptors(&manifest) hook at plugin registration time (PluginHost::load_plugin/hot_swap_plugin), following the crate's existing export_handlers() pattern. list_os_resource_descriptors()/os_resource_descriptor()/os_resource_media_capability() become registry lookups. Delete dimension-from-kind-prefix string inference. Thread ResourceKindSpec (from framework/plugin/rs's AppBuilder::resource_kind()) through AppDefinition so it round-trips through the manifest — hoist the canonical ResourceKindSpec/OsMediaCapability definitions into framework/core/rs/lib.rs (dedup the two existing copies). Add .resource_kind(...) declarations to every app plugin crate's AppBuilder chain reflecting what OS_RESOURCE_KIND_IDS used to hardcode. Update framework/core/js/index.ts mirror if needed.
summary:
Made the OS resource catalog manifest-driven instead of a hardcoded app roster.

**framework/product/os/core/rs/lib.rs (my primary ownership)**: Deleted `OS_RESOURCE_KIND_IDS` (26-entry const array), `descriptor_presentation()` (per-kind match), `descriptor_dimension_from_kind_prefix()` (2d./3d./5d. string inference), and the hardcoded `OsMediaCapability` enum + `os_resource_media_capability()` match (`"3d.cad"|"3d.process"|"form.dictionary" => Brep`). Replaced with a `RESOURCE_KIND_REGISTRY: LazyLock<Mutex<HashMap<OsResourceKindId, ResourceKindEntry>>>` in the `registry` module (mirrors the crate's existing `export_handlers()` pattern) plus: `register_resource_descriptors(&PluginManifest)` (hooked into `PluginHost::load_plugin` and `hot_swap_plugin`), `register_resource_descriptor(&ResourceKindSpec)` (direct single-entry registration for tests), `list_os_resource_descriptors()` (sorted by kind id), `os_resource_descriptor(kind)` (registry lookup; unregistered kinds fall back to a bare placeholder with `dimension: "unknown"` — no more prefix inference), `os_resource_media_capability(kind)` (registry lookup; unregistered defaults to `MeshOnly`). `parameter.value` is seeded as a framework-level builtin (it's a generic cross-app parameter-port kind, not one app's document format). Checked whether `OsAppRegistration` validates referenced resource kinds exist — it does not (no such check existed before my change either), so no new validation was added there. Also fixed 6 pre-existing compile breaks in this file (found while driving `cargo test` green): 5 test-module `AppDefinition{...}` literals and 1 `resolve_os_app_definition` literal missing `media_kinds`/`media_inputs`/`media_outputs`/`resource_kinds` (added by a concurrent MEDIA-TYPE-LATTICE-IN-FRAMEWORK-CORE ticket to `AppDefinition` itself, landed mid-session), plus updated the `vfs_inputs_folder_lists_a_dwg_import_row_for_2d_kinds` test to call `register_resource_descriptor` since the registry now starts empty instead of knowing all kinds implicitly.

**framework/core/rs/lib.rs**: Hoisted the canonical `OsMediaCapability` enum and new `ResourceKindSpec` struct here (new `//#region ResourceKind`, right after `//#region MediaFormat`) — dedupes what used to be two separate copies in `framework/plugin/rs` and `framework/product/os/core/rs` (both now re-export verbatim), the exact hoist the prior EXTRACT-SHARED-PLUGIN-SDK-PRIMITIVES ticket flagged as its wave-2 follow-up. Added `resource_kinds: Vec<ResourceKindSpec>` to `AppDefinition` so it round-trips through the plugin manifest wire format (previously it only lived Rust-side on the SDK's `App` wrapper and was silently dropped at `PluginBundle::register_app`). Added ts-rs typegen derives + export-test entries for both new types. Fixed 2 pre-existing `AppDefinition{...}` literals here too (same missing-fields issue).

**framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs**: Replaced the local `OsMediaCapability`/`ResourceKindSpec` definitions with `pub use semio_framework_core::{OsMediaCapability, ResourceKindSpec};`. `AppBuilder::build_definition()` now threads `self.resource_kinds` into the `AppDefinition` it builds. Removed the now-redundant `App.resource_kinds` field and the `mem::take` dance in `App::from_builder` (resource kinds live only on `AppDefinition.resource_kinds` now, the single source of truth).

**framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs**: Fixed a pre-existing test-fixture `AppDefinition{...}` literal missing `terminology_documents` + the 4 new fields (found while verifying; unrelated to my ticket but blocking compilation).

**22 app plugin crates** — added `.resource_kind(ResourceKindSpec{...})` to each app's `AppBuilder` chain, reconstructing the id/name/source_format/component_kind/dimension exactly from the deleted `descriptor_presentation()` match arms, cross-checked against the real `register_2d_export_handlers`/`register_mesh_exporter`/etc. calls each app already makes (ground truth for which app owns which kind) and against `s/manifest/resources.manifest.json` (a pre-existing, more complete hand-authored fixture with the same id/name/sourceFormat/componentKind/dimension shape, used as the primary source for names/formats/dimensions I couldn't otherwise verify):
- note/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 2d.note (2D Note / note.document / note / 2d / MeshOnly)
- draw/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 2d.drawing (2D Drawing / draw.document / draw / 2d / MeshOnly)
- raster/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 2d.raster (2D Raster / raster.document / raster / 2d / MeshOnly)
- gis/plugin/rs/lib.rs (gis2d) — 2d.map (2D Map / gis.map / gismap / 2d / MeshOnly)
- procedural/plugin/rs/lib.rs (procedural2d) — 2d.procedural (2D Procedural / procedural.2d / procedural2d / 2d / MeshOnly)
- procedural/plugin/rs/lib.rs (procedural3d) — 3d.procedural (3D Procedural / procedural.3d / procedural3d / 3d / MeshOnly)
- shooting/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 2d.shooting (2D Shooting / shooting.scene / shooting / 2d / MeshOnly)
- puzzle/plugin/rs/lib.rs (puzzle2d/3d/5d) — 2d.puzzle, 3d.puzzle, 5d.puzzle (MeshOnly each)
- cad/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 3d.cad (3D CAD / cad.scene / cad / 3d / Brep)
- process/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 3d.process (3D Process / process.3d / process3d / 3d / Brep) — this kind was NEVER in the old `OS_RESOURCE_KIND_IDS` list even though `os_resource_media_capability`'s old match arm referenced it and process's own `register_mesh_exporter` calls used it; a latent gap I fixed as a byproduct.
- flow/plugin/rs/lib.rs — computation.flow (Flow / flow.document / flow / graph / MeshOnly)
- trinity/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Trinity Jack) — graph.trinity (Trinity Graph / trinity.graph / trinity / graph / MeshOnly)
- infinite/board/port/directed/dag/plugin/rs/lib.rs — graph.dag (DAG / flow.dag / dag / graph / MeshOnly)
- writer/plugin/rs/lib.rs — text.document (Text Document / writer.document / writer / text / MeshOnly)
- forms/plugin/rs/lib.rs — form.dictionary (Form Dictionary / forms.dictionary / forms / data / Brep)
- framework/product/presentation/plugin/rs/lib.rs — presentation.deck (Presentation Deck / presentation.deck / panel / 2d / MeshOnly)
- lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 3d.lowpoly AND 3d.mesh (both registered; lowpoly's own export handlers use both kind strings)
- sequence/plugin/rs/lib.rs — computation.sequence (Sequence / sequence.fixture / sequence / graph / MeshOnly)
- layout/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 2d.layout (Layout / layout.fixture / layout / 2d / MeshOnly)
- imperative/plugin/rs/lib.rs — computation.imperative (Imperative / imperative.document / imperative / graph / MeshOnly)
- vcs/plugin/rs/lib.rs — vcs.document (VCS Document / vcs.demo / vcs / data / MeshOnly)
- remodel/plugin/rs/lib.rs — 3d.remodel (3D Remodel / remodel.scene / remodel / 3d / MeshOnly) — also never in the old list (remodel's own `register_mesh_exporter` calls use "3d.remodel", a separate kind from lowpoly's "3d.mesh"); another latent gap fixed as a byproduct.
- sourcing/plugin/rs/lib.rs (Curate) — catalogue.kinds AND catalogue.sourcing (the latter also never in the old list; matches sourcing's own domain).

**Ambiguous / flagged for follow-up**: `kit.compose` (old list had it; presentation manifest says componentKind "virtualFileSystem", sourceFormat "compose.kit") has no owning `AppBuilder`-based plugin crate — `./compose` is a separate technology with no `plugin/rs`, and CLAUDE.md explicitly forbids mixing technologies without being asked, so I deliberately left it unregistered rather than guess an owner. `gis3d`/`3d.map` and `protocol/rs` `Trinity Rewrite` were intentionally NOT given resource kinds since they weren't in the old `OS_RESOURCE_KIND_IDS` list either (kept faithful to the old roster there). `s/plugin/rs/lib.rs` also registers export/import handlers for "2d.drawing" (reusing draw's format) but deliberately was not given its own `.resource_kind()` declaration since draw already owns that catalog entry.

**Pre-existing/concurrent compile breaks found but NOT fixed (out of scope, confirmed via `git diff --stat` isolating my edits to ~9-10 lines each in every case, and cross-confirmed via a full `cargo check --workspace --keep-going` sweep)**: raster-plugin (missing `default_one`/`default_true` helper fns), forms-plugin/writer-plugin/trinity-plugin/sequence-plugin/imperative-plugin/vcs-plugin (missing `loading` field in various `Ui*Node` literals — same class of break the prior EXTRACT-SHARED-PLUGIN-SDK-PRIMITIVES ticket already fixed once elsewhere, regressed again via a concurrent ui_wgpu change), vcs-plugin also has 4 `cannot find type HashMap` errors from a missing import elsewhere in the file. The full workspace is additionally blocked by massive unrelated churn in `architect_program` (1887 errors), `animate_core` (169 errors), `norm_en_1990`, `s-plugin`, `reasoning-mindmap-plugin`, `protocol-module-procedural`, `mathematical-plugin` — none touched by or related to this ticket.

**Verification** (isolated `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`, `RUSTC_WRAPPER=""` to sidestep severe shared-target-dir lock contention and sccache-daemon contention from many concurrent agent sessions on this machine — repo-wide, not ticket-specific):
- `cargo check -p semio-framework-core` — clean.
- `cargo check -p semio-framework-plugin` — clean (only pre-existing unrelated warnings).
- `cargo check -p semio-framework-os` — clean.
- `cargo test -p semio-framework-os` — 30/30 passed.
- Individually checked all 22 touched app plugin crates: 15 clean (note, draw, gis, procedural, shooting, puzzle, cad, process, flow, dag, presentation, lowpoly, layout, remodel, sourcing), 7 blocked by the pre-existing/unrelated breaks listed above (raster, forms, writer, trinity, sequence, vcs, imperative).
- `cargo check --workspace --keep-going` — completed; confirmed none of my 3 owned framework crates appear in its "could not compile" list; the 7 app-crate failures above match exactly (same error counts) confirming they're pre-existing, not caused by this change.

**JS mirror**: `framework/core/js/generated/manifest.ts` is ts-rs-generated (via `bun nx run @semio-tech/framework-core:generate`) and was already stale before my change (missing `mediaKinds`/`mediaInputs`/`mediaOutputs` from the concurrent MEDIA-TYPE-LATTICE-IN-FRAMEWORK-CORE ticket, whose own scope explicitly includes regenerating it). `framework/core/js/index.ts` re-exports `AppDefinition` from that generated file rather than hand-mirroring it, so no hand-written TS type was needed for `ResourceKindSpec` — I added the `#[cfg_attr(feature = "typegen", derive(ts_rs::TS))]` derives and export-test entries so the next regeneration (whoever runs it) picks up `OsMediaCapability`/`ResourceKindSpec`/`AppDefinition.resourceKinds` automatically. I deliberately did not run the regeneration myself given the size of the resulting diff would conflate my change with the concurrent ticket's already-pending one, and given severe environment time constraints this session.

All original files backed up under this ticket's backup/ folder before editing.
